digest.overview: Narrow 5-hour window dominated by Anthropic's Claude-powered crypto attack research, a multi-lab call for US AI governance, and Google's $205B capex hike rattling markets. Open-weight encoder drops and agentic scientific computing notes fill the rest.

top_story.headline: Claude Mythos Preview cracks cryptographic weaknesses
top_story.summary: Anthropic researchers used the preview model to find improved attacks on cryptographic algorithms, detailed in new research post. HN discussion surged to 93 points.
top_story.why_it_matters: Demonstrates frontier models accelerating real security research; raises questions on dual-use and refusal policies for white-hat vs black-hat tasks.

sentiment.label: mixed
sentiment.summary: Community notes impressive research capability alongside unease over escalating capex ($195-205B at Google), governance demands, and power constraints on data centers.

model_releases.headline: LFM2.5-Encoders: fast long-context on CPU
model_releases.summary: Liquid AI releases 230M/350M multilingual bidirectional encoders optimized for low-latency inference even on CPU.

model_releases.headline: Microsoft Mage-VL: codec-native streaming multimodal
model_releases.summary: 4B visual encoder trained from scratch for efficient image/video understanding and proactive streaming.

frontier_labs.headline: AI leaders urge US government action on automated AI
frontier_labs.summary: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, Microsoft, Mistral employees sign statement calling for coordinated governance and potential slowdown on frontier development.

frontier_labs.headline: Google raises 2026 capex to $205B
frontier_labs.summary: Updated guidance from $190B shocks investors; lower end still $195B amid AI infrastructure buildout.

frontier_labs.headline: OpenAI: scientific computing in the age of agentic AI
frontier_labs.summary: Field report details AI coding agents accelerating genomics software modernization and discovery.

influencer_takes.author: Ethan Mollick
influencer_takes.quote: There is, as everyone expected, a flood of AI books. And it is crowding out human authors: 'No-AI books, on their own, earn less per book than they did in 2023 in 7 of 8 genres.'
influencer_takes.context: Quantifies market displacement in publishing, one of few concrete economic impact data points this window.

research_radar.headline: Research directions in condensation: varieties of objectivity
research_radar.summary: Alignment Forum survey explores mathematical theory of organizing world descriptions into conceptual parts.

post_ideas.hook: Claude just helped break crypto primitives
post_ideas.draft: Anthropic's latest preview model didn't just chat—it found better attacks on cryptographic algorithms. White-hat defense implications are immediate; refusal policies now look even more mismatched to reality.
post_ideas.why_viral: Directly ties model capability to real security research with tension on dual-use.

post_ideas.draft: Google lifted capex guidance to $205B. Investors sold off anyway. The infrastructure bet is now so large that even modest misses hurt sentiment.
post_ideas.why_viral: Numbers shock + market reaction creates contrarian angle on 'AI is cheap' narrative.

post_ideas.hook: Labs sign letter asking government to slow frontier AI
post_ideas.draft: Employees from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and others just petitioned the US government for faster governance and possible development brakes. Internal consensus shifting publicly.
post_ideas.why_viral: Rare cross-lab alignment on policy creates surprise and debate on motives.
